sheet.title: Donation receipt
sheet.noGoods: No goods or services were provided in return for this donation.
sheet.noTax: This receipt does not give a tax deduction.
sheet.cancelled: Cancelled: this donation was refunded, so this receipt is no longer valid.

expired.title: This receipt link has expired
expired.body: Receipt links work for 7 days. You can ask for a new one with your email address and the receipt number.

request.title: Get a new receipt link
request.lead: Enter the email address you gave and your receipt number. If they match a donation, we email a new link, valid for 7 days.

number.label: Receipt number
number.hint: It looks like FOA-RCPT-2627-000123 and is in the thank-you email.

request.sent: If the email address and receipt number match a donation, a new link is on its way. Check your inbox and spam folder.
request.rateLimited: You've asked a few times already. Please try again in an hour.
request.invalid: Enter your email address and the receipt number.
request.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again in a few minutes.

notFound.title: We couldn't find this receipt
notFound.body: The link may be mistyped or cut short. You can ask for a new one with your email address and the receipt number.
